newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand may amend foreign stake limit in banks.
newsitem.headline: Thailand may amend foreign stake limit in banks.

text.p: Bank of Thailand governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Monday the central bank is considering amending a law limiting foreign holdings in commercial banks and finance companies.
"The central bank is considering a change in the limit of foreign holdings in Thai financial institutions. The new limit is being worked out," Rerngchai told reporters.
Foreigners at present are prohibited from holding more than a 25 percent stake in a commercial bank and 40 percent in a finance firm.
The plan to amend the limit on foreign holdings was sparked by increased foreign investment in Thailand, Rerngchai said.
